Resize Image

Change image dimensions for JPG, PNG, and WebP. Fit inside custom widths and heights without distortion.

↗ Drop your images here

or choose from your device (or paste with Ctrl+V)

JPG, PNG, WebP · Up to 30 MB per file

    Choose a file to get started.

    Three simple steps

    1. Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image or paste from clipboard (Ctrl+V).
    2. Enter width and height, side-by-side. Keep proportions checked to prevent distortion.
    3. Download your resized image or send it directly to another tool.
    Stays on your device
    File processing happens in this browser. No account or upload required.

    30 files maximum for multi-file tools, 100 MB combined. Image limit: 40 megapixels. PDF output: 2,000 pages.

    Good to know

    Keeping proportions scales the image to fit inside your target dimensions without stretching. Width and height are positioned side-by-side for quick editing.

    Keep your original files. Check the downloaded result before submitting or sharing it. Modern desktop browsers work best for larger documents.

    Does OurSolver store my files?

    No. Files are held in browser memory during processing. Clear the files or close the page when you finish. Downloaded files remain on your device.

    Why did processing fail?

    A file may be damaged, encrypted, unsupported or too large for your device's available memory. Try a smaller file and an updated browser. Read troubleshooting tips.
